component.name: Pistisai
component.summary: Bridge cloud-based AI services with local AI models

description.p: Pistisai is a cross-platform application that bridges cloud-based AI services with local AI models, providing a hybrid AI architecture with privacy-first design.

ul.li: Seamlessly switch between cloud AI (OpenAI, Anthropic) and local models (Ollama)
Privacy-first: sensitive data stays local while leveraging cloud AI when needed
Cross-platform support for Windows, Linux, and Web

description.p: Latest release with bug fixes and improvements
